remarks: Beautifully situated within the coveted Silver Spring community on the former Firestone estate thoroughbred racetrack, this sophisticated Colonial offers modern luxury and prime location on a private road. Great curb appeal and lush landscaping welcome you to this updated, meticulous move-in ready home adorned with custom millwork, gleaming hardwood floors and functional flow. Dreamy NEW white chef's kitchen boasts quartz counters, Subzero, Thermador gas range and large center island & opens to the fabulous Family Rm accented w/ built-ins, vaulted ceiling and fireplace framed by a magazine-worthy mantle. Formal Dining Rm and Living Rm invite family and guests, while a private Study offers quiet work-from-home space. Easy entertaining on the spacious Trex deck overlooking the level backyard. Upstairs, retire to the Primary Ste with elegant marble bathroom, double sinks and two walk-in closets. Three light & bright BRs and spacious hall bath complete the upper floor. Ready to exercise or relax? Head to the fully finished LL with tons of space and amazing mudroom w/ walk-out access to level back yard for all sorts of recreation in this private neighborhood - perfect for walking, bicycling & enjoying nature. Whole house generator and security system provide additional comfort. Enjoy Wilton's top-rated schools, lively town center, Ambler Farm & Weir Farm Nat'l Park and the close-by downtown of Ridgefield's main street.
